persona: Tomas, a wedding photographer who cannot code
plain_request: When I upload a photo, I want it automatically resized into web, thumbnail, and print sizes and stored in the cloud. I just want to drop a file and have it work — and obviously my clients' photos must stay private.
title: serverless photo-resize API
critical_rationale: The user says 'photos must stay private' but cannot name a control; world-class delivery enforces OWASP ASVS (owasp namespace) — schema validation at the upload boundary, secrets via env, no hardcoded credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Uploading an image triggers automatic resizing into web, thumbnail, and print variants
Every uploaded file is validated (type, size) at the boundary before any processing
Storage credentials come from the environment, never from source code
Only the owner can read their stored photos
